description: Install Ventoy on USB drive E: (128GB, letter confirmed by Nasif). Download latest Ventoy, run installer, push result to relay.
command:
$driveLetter = 'E'
$vol = Get-Volume -DriveLetter $driveLetter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $vol) { Write-Host "ERROR: Drive ${driveLetter}: not found"; exit 1 }
$part = Get-Partition -DriveLetter $driveLetter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $part) { Write-Host "ERROR: No partition for ${driveLetter}:"; exit 1 }
$diskNum = $part.DiskNumber
$physDrive = "\\.\PhysicalDrive$diskNum"
$szGB = [math]::Round((Get-Disk -Number $diskNum).Size/1GB,1)
Write-Host "USB E: = disk $diskNum ($szGB GB) $physDrive"
$outDir = "$env:TEMP\ventoy_setup"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null
$rel = Invoke-RestMethod 'https://api.github.com/repos/ventoy/Ventoy/releases/latest' -UseBasicParsing
$asset = $rel.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -match 'ventoy-.*-windows\.zip' } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $asset) { Write-Host 'ERROR: Ventoy windows zip not found in release'; exit 1 }
Write-Host "Downloading $($asset.name)..."
Invoke-WebRequest $asset.browser_download_url -OutFile "$outDir\ventoy.zip" -UseBasicParsing
Expand-Archive "$outDir\ventoy.zip" -DestinationPath $outDir -Force
$exe = Get-ChildItem $outDir -Recurse -Filter 'Ventoy2Disk.exe' | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $exe) { Write-Host 'ERROR: Ventoy2Disk.exe not found'; exit 1 }
Write-Host "Running: $($exe.FullName) -I $physDrive"
$proc = Start-Process -FilePath $exe.FullName -ArgumentList "-I $physDrive" -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$exitCode = $proc.ExitCode
Write-Host "Exit code: $exitCode"
$ts = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'relay\cmd_results' | Out-Null
@{ ts=$ts; drive="${driveLetter}:"; disk_num=$diskNum; phys_drive=$physDrive; size_gb=$szGB; ventoy_version=$rel.tag_name; exit_code=$exitCode; status=if($exitCode -eq 0){'OK'}else{"ERROR_$exitCode"} } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content 'relay\cmd_results\ventoy_result.json'
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal add relay\cmd_results\ventoy_result.json
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal commit -m "ventoy E: done $ts exit=$exitCode"
git -C C:\Users\endos\Signal push origin relay
Write-Host 'Ventoy setup complete'
note: E: drive confirmed by Nasif 2026-10-27T12:39Z. Wipes USB and installs Ventoy.
